unit.unitinstructions:
Kennesaw Sociology and Criminal Justice Faculty and Administration

This tutor covers 27 full-time faculty members, 8 department administration entries, and 3 additional Radow/graduate leadership entries.

  • Faculty cards: Prompt text uses research-interest information.
  • Admin cards: Prompt text uses role and, when published, expertise or focus areas.
  • Response: Type the person's full name without any middle initial.
  • Source rule: If source pages omit expertise details, cards do not invent them.

Use the image and text prompt together to retrieve the correct name.

learningsession.calculateProbability: p.y = .73* pFunc.logitdec( p.overallOutcomeHistory.slice( Math.max(p.overallOutcomeHistory.length-60,  0),   p.overallOutcomeHistory.length),  .95)+ .52* Math.log(1+p.stimSuccessCount) + 2.17 * pFunc.recency(p.stimSecsSinceLastShown,  .30) ; p.probability = 1.0 / (1.0 + Math.exp(-p.y));  return p
